verdict.rationale: Greenhouse exposes some data programmatically. The Job Board API returns a simple JSON representation of offices, departments and published jobs, and partner APIs let you retrieve candidate stage and status. Nothing in the evidence shows a full account export, bulk candidate or application data dump, or a documented offboarding path, so only a small, glancing slice of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account data export, export of candidate/application/scorecard data in open formats (CSV/JSON), explicit read or export coverage of the core recruiting API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data portability.
